name: Single-Leg Calf Raise
sourceScope: Candidate: two intact retained endpoints, whole-source3+32px y registration, existing calf/soleus palette only. No body/equipment edits. Not accepted or registered.
setup: Stand on one foot on a step's edge, ball of the foot planted, heel hanging free.
Hold a wall or rail for balance only — don't pull yourself up with it.

beats.label: Low
beats.cue: Lower heel slightly below the step.

beats.label: Brace
beats.cue: Keep your knee straight; balance lightly.

beats.label: Top
beats.cue: Rise onto your toes without pulling.

beats.label: Hold
beats.cue: Pause tall; squeeze your working calf.

beats.label: Lower
beats.cue: Lower slowly through the shown range.

beats.label: Reset
beats.cue: Reset below step; keep forefoot planted.

findingsPendingReview: Modest pictured below-step heel range, not a deep or maximum stretch claim.
Small inherited posture/contour differences; no established material proportion failure, no claim of exact anatomical identity.
Several-pixel residual original step/rail and hand/forefoot contact differences; not strict1px hardware certification.
Two physical endpoints repeated honestly across six paths; no authored intermediate or continuous trajectory.
Only the source-visible near calf/soleus is coloured; no invented hidden-side muscle geometry.
